findings.evidence: Grep for theorems named `conjugationOfMaximalTotallyReal*` lists only _apply, _conjugationOfMaximalTotallyReal, _involutive, _eq_self_iff, _unique, _congr_range and _natural; none evaluates the map at `f w`.
findings.fix: Add `@[simp] theorem LinearMap.conjugationOfMaximalTotallyReal_apply_self : f.conjugationOfMaximalTotallyReal hf hmax (f w) = f w`. With `maximalRealFormConjugationDiffeomorph_apply`, simp then also rewrites the bundle conjugation at `⟨x, i x w⟩`.
findings.issue: There is no lemma for `f.conjugationOfMaximalTotallyReal hf hmax (f w)`. `_eq_self_iff` only proves the equation as a whole goal; it cannot rewrite `conj (f w)` inside a larger term such as `conj (f w) + x` or `conj (c • f w)`. `_congr_range` (lines 209-213) has to work around this with `(eq_self_iff …).mpr`.

findings.evidence: Grep for theorems named `conjugationOfComplexification*` lists only _apply, _conjugationOfComplexification, _involutive, _eq_self_iff, _unique and _natural. The proofs of `_unique` and `_natural` each repeat the `_apply`, `symm_apply_apply`, `tmulConj_tmul` simp chain that this lemma would replace.
findings.fix: Add `@[simp] theorem conjugationOfComplexification_apply_tmul (e) (c : ℂ) (w : W) : conjugationOfComplexification e (e (c ⊗ₜ[ℝ] w)) = e (star c ⊗ₜ[ℝ] w)`. Its proof is `_apply`, `symm_apply_apply` and `tmulConj_tmul`.
findings.issue: Same gap for `LinearEquiv.conjugationOfComplexification`. Its action on the image of a pure tensor, `conj (e (c ⊗ₜ w)) = e (star c ⊗ₜ w)`, has no lemma, and `_apply` is not `@[simp]`, so simp cannot compute it.

summary: Neither new conjugation has a simp lemma giving its value on a real-form vector, so callers must go through `_eq_self_iff.mpr` to rewrite it. The rest of the surface (fixed locus, uniqueness, independence from parametrisation, naturality, extension uniqueness) is complete, with no compatibility layer and no exposed bodies.
